label: Idea
conversation: Tell me what caught your attention, even if it is unfinished.
record: Your observations, a working title, the possible angle, and open questions.
move: When you ask to develop the idea, I clarify the reader and takeaway and begin research or drafting.

label: Research
conversation: We explore the angle and check what needs evidence.
record: Sources, verified claims, uncertainties, related posts, and the agreed direction.
move: When enough material supports a useful draft, I start writing. Personal reflections can go straight to drafting.

label: Drafting
conversation: I write in your voice and incorporate the experiences you have supplied.
record: The current full draft, alternatives considered, and unresolved questions.
move: A complete draft moves to review. Saving a draft to an external service requires authorization and a configured connection.

label: Review
conversation: You react naturally: change the opening, add an example, soften a claim, or keep this version.
record: Your feedback and decisions, revised text, evidence checks, and the your publishing service draft link when available.
move: When the draft is reviewed and material issues are resolved, it becomes ready. Bigger changes can return it to drafting or research.

label: Ready
conversation: The article is prepared. You decide whether and when it goes live.
record: The reviewed draft and a clear next action: awaiting publication instruction, or carrying out an instruction already given.
move: An explicit publish request goes to published after verification; a schedule request goes to scheduled after your publishing service confirms it. Ready alone grants no publication permission.

label: Scheduled · optional
conversation: You specify when to publish. Confirm the date, time, and timezone.
record: The confirmed your publishing service schedule and link. Exact time and timezone are retained in decisions.
move: After the publication time, ask me to check it. A connected agent can verify the live post. Narration requires a separate integration and request. No background watcher is installed.

label: Published
conversation: I confirm the live article and report any remaining narration work.
record: The verified public link, publication result, and separate narration status.
move: If narration is requested, mark it complete only after verifying the public player. Later revisions keep the post’s publication status and are tracked in the timeline and next action.
